source_refs.note: Exercise 8.2, Question 10: book p.157 (PDF 162). Answer key book p.301-302 (PDF 306-307): RHS printed 2^(n-1), correct 2^n - 1; no answer in the key. Solution book PDF 741-770 used as a reference only.

blocks.explanation:
Bachon, pehle ek zaroori baat: kitab mein right side \(2^{n-1}\) chhapi hai jo ghalat hai; sahi value \(2^n - 1\) hai (neeche "Kitab ki ghalti" dekhein). Hum sahi statement saabit karenge.
Chaal: \((1 + x)^n\) mein \(x = 1\) rakh do; har \(x\) ki power 1 ban jayegi aur sirf coefficients bachenge.
Plan: \((1 + x)^n\) likho, \(x = 1\) rakho, phir \(\binom{n}{0} = 1\) nikaal do.
Yeh sawal 'Show that' wala hai, yani humein koi number nahi nikalna balke ek baat saabit karni hai. Saabit karte waqt har qadam ki wajah likhna zaroori hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: jama \(\binom{n}{1} + \binom{n}{2} + \dots + \binom{n}{n}\).
Saabit karna hai: yeh \(2^n - 1\) ke barabar hai.
Tareeqa: \((1 + x)^n\) ki binomial expansion, khaas value \(x = 1\) ke saath. Binomial coefficients ke jama wale sawalon mein \(x = 1\) ya \(x = -1\) rakhna aam aur taqatwar chaal hai.

\((1 + x)^n\) kholein
\[(1 + x)^n = \binom{n}{0} + \binom{n}{1}x\]
\[+ \binom{n}{2}x^2 + \dots + \binom{n}{n}x^n\]
Kyun: Binomial theorem jahan pehla term 1 hai; 1 ki har power 1 hai, is liye har term sirf \(\binom{n}{r}x^r\) reh jata hai.
Misaal: \(n = 2\) par \((1 + x)^2 = 1 + 2x + x^2\), yani coefficients 1, 2, 1 hain.

\(x = 1\) rakhein
\[2^n = \binom{n}{0} + \binom{n}{1} + \binom{n}{2}\]
\[+ \dots + \binom{n}{n}\]
Kyun: Yeh expansion har \(x\) ke liye sach hai, is liye \(x = 1\) bhi rakh sakte hain. Left side \((1 + 1)^n = 2^n\) aur right side par har \(x^r = 1\). Matlab saare binomial coefficients ka jama \(2^n\) hai (kitab ke deduction (iii) mein bhi yahi hai).
Misaal: \(n = 2\) par \(1 + 2 + 1 = 4 = 2^2\). Dekha, coefficients ka jama waqai \(2^n\) hai.

Pehla coefficient hata dein
\[\binom{n}{0} = 1\]
\[\binom{n}{1} + \binom{n}{2} + \dots + \binom{n}{n} = 2^n - 1\]
Kyun: Hamara jama \(\binom{n}{1}\) se shuru hota hai, \(\binom{n}{0}\) se nahi. Is liye dono taraf se \(\binom{n}{0} = 1\) minus kiya.
Dhyan dein: \(2^n - 1\) aur \(2^{n-1}\) bilkul alag hain: pehle mein poore \(2^n\) mein se 1 minus hota hai, doosre mein power mein se.

Tasdeeq: \(n = 3\)
\[\binom{3}{1} + \binom{3}{2} + \binom{3}{3} = 3 + 3 + 1 = 7\]
\[2^3 - 1 = 7 \;\checkmark\]
\[2^{3-1} = 4 \ne 7\]
Kyun: Chhoti value par \(2^n - 1\) sahi nikla, aur saath hi saaf ho gaya ke kitab wala \(2^{n-1}\) sahi nahi.
Tasdeeq hamesha kisi chhoti value se kar lein; yeh do minute ka kaam hai magar ghalat formula ko foran pakad leta hai, chahe woh kitab mein hi kyun na chhapa ho.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab right side \(2^{n-1}\) print karti hai. Yeh \(n \ge 2\) ke liye ghalat hai: misaal \(n = 2\) par \(\binom{2}{1} + \binom{2}{2} = 3\), jabke \(2^{2-1} = 2\). Sahi statement: \(\binom{n}{1} + \binom{n}{2} + \dots + \binom{n}{n} = 2^n - 1\). (\(2^{n-1}\) asal mein ek aur jama ka jawab hai: \(\binom{n}{1} + \binom{n}{3} + \binom{n}{5} + \dots = 2^{n-1}\), yani odd jagah wale coefficients ka jama.) Answer key mein is sawal ka jawab nahi diya gaya.
